configuration.candidate_structure: Each fitted global model receives weight 0.5 and the frozen original-seed airport predictions weight 0.5. Candidate families combine these pipelines with declared weights.
configuration.prior_evidence: Phase-5R first batch failed promotion. No weather-based target fit or held-out score was examined before this declaration. Weather coverage and variable quality were audited without target labels.
configuration.refit_iterations: Rounded median of October-selected counts separately for each selected new native component. Retain frozen v4 and airport refits for old members. January-November only, all December flight groups protected.
configuration.selection: Six fits, three variants on both frozen folds. Four candidate families, each mixed with v4 at 25/50/75/100 percent (16 recipes). Require at least 0.5 percent lower complete-set RMSE on BOTH folds; minimize equal mean relative RMSE. Weights are common to every airport and fold.
